    Corner bimodules and their radical layers #

    For a split basic algebra B with idempotents e_x, this file studies the corner e_x B e_y as a bimodule over the corner algebras e_x B e_x and e_y B e_y (note v2, Section 4):

    • SplitBasicData.IsBimod x y U: U ⊆ e_x B e_y is a subbimodule;
    • SplitBasicData.layer x y: the radical layers D₀ = e_x B e_y, D_{i+1} = (e_x J e_x) D_i + D_i (e_y J e_y);
    • SplitBasicData.eq_layer_of_isLow: if every layer D_i / D_{i+1} has dimension at most one, every subbimodule is one of the D_i.
